skill.summary: LYGO-MINT verifier for Champion/alignment prompt packs: canonicalize a pack, generate a deterministic SHA-256 hash, write append-only and canonical ledgers, and output a portable Anchor Snippet for posting anywhere (Moltbook/Moltx/X/Discord/4claw). Use when you need verifiable, hash-addressed alignment artifacts (Champion packs, summon prompts, workflow packs) with receipts and optional anchor backfill.

latestVersion.changelog: Clarify security model: document that scripts wrap local tools in tools/lygo_mint, recommend reviewing those helpers and using non-secret prompt packs / controlled environments for minting. Remove overstrong 'never print secrets' claim.
